fixes: An exclusive panel now waits for the actual native editor to save/pause before hiding it, allowing the Photo context repaint button to open.
Canvas blur no longer extends the edit guard by itself; a real held pointer still rejects a competing edit.
limits: An immediately changing text selection can be safely rejected and requires selection to settle; no stale target is applied.
The observed controls and sample objects were exercised, not every upstream professional menu or every object type.
